title: Eusebius, Praeparatio Ecclesiastica (Lost)
english: I read Eusebius's Praeparatio Ecclesiastica in several books, from which selections are made. This work has perished.
translator_notes: Pass A≠B for claim photius-bibliotheca-densify; justification reviews/justifications/bibl_codex_11.json

Codex 11 of 279; Eusebius's Praeparatio Ecclesiastica — lost work, known only from Photius's summary. Distinct from the extant Praeparatio Evangelica.
